result:
Disk full killed api. `/var/lib/stockroom` ran out of space, DB write failed, api exited and never restarted.

Timeline (2026-03-09):
- `03:09:03` `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%`
- `03:13:30` `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%`. 8 points in 4.5 min, so something was writing fast.
- `03:14:00` `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`
- `03:14:03` `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`
- `03:14:06` `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`
- `03:16:00` onward: `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 min, through `05:28:00`.

Api served zero requests after `03:14:06`. Still down when log ends at `05:29:57`, so outage is at least 2h16m. Proxy and web kept returning 200 throughout.

`cache: slow command` warnings (100–149 ms, every ~5 min) run the whole log, before and after the crash. Not the cause.

Log does not show what filled the disk.

Log dates are 2026-03-09, not last night (today is 2026-10-04). Check this is the right file.
